fields.statement: At 423ba9c5, by hand with a scratch build (go build -o outside PATH) in a scratch git repo, RHIZA_*/REX_* unset: accepted a change set, started the real daemon (rhiza daemon --max-runs 3 --min-free 1000T --permission-mode plan; the disk guard kept it from starting any run). daemon status showed running, the skip 'Skip me: serves no milestone' and disk low. Rebuilt the binary in place; the daemon logged 'binary changed, re-executing' and the same pid took the lock again. A watcher saved every version of .git/rhiza/daemon.state.json: the new image's first write had the new start 01:26:16.082 with the old image's last poll 01:26:15.741, the skip, max runs 3 and disk_low, and a zero stopped time; its own first poll then wrote last poll 01:26:16.099. daemon status after the re-exec showed running, Started 01:26:16, the skip, no stopped line; after SIGINT it showed 'Daemon not running' with 'Last daemon ... stopped'. go test ./internal/api -run TestDaemon -count=1 passes.

At 423ba9c5, by hand with a scratch build in a scratch git repo, RHIZA_* unset: created change set A, propose/accept/land, wrote A into .rhiza/local/change. rhiza status showed '(landed): Daemon test cs' and 'next: rhiza change use --none'; rhiza status --hook printed 'The current change set is landed; clear it with `rhiza change use --none`.'; rhiza add capability other exited 3 with 'next: rhiza change use --none', and --json gave code conflict with the same next; the current file still named A afterwards. After rhiza change use --none, status showed 'Change set: none current' with no hint and the hook 'No current change set.' go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/status-terminal-current passes.
